headline: Police in Cologne have confiscated a robot accused of groping a 16-year-old girl and are examining whether two young men were controlling it.
score_reason: Pool score 7 lowered by 1: the incident was on 10 Oct 2026 and first reported on 12 Oct 2026; today's new fact is the police probe of the two young men.
importance_line: The alleged victim is a 16-year-old girl, and the case may test who is responsible when a remotely steered robot harms someone, but police have not said whether anyone was controlling the robot and every accusation is still an allegation.
summary: BBC News reports that police in Cologne, Germany, have confiscated a red and gold robot, about 120 cm (3.9 ft) tall, that allegedly grabbed a 16-year-old girl's buttocks near a fast-food outlet close to midnight on Saturday 10 Oct 2026; the case was first reported on 12 Oct 2026, and the new step is a police investigation of the robot's 16-year-old owner and a 19-year-old companion, who are believed to have streamed the incident live. Police also seized two mobile phones and are trying to establish whether someone was deliberately controlling the robot's movements at the time.
